results.title: real login of the initial ADMIN through the gateway
the ADMIN token is a human ADMIN token (roles=[ADMIN], sub=user id)
ADMIN registers a SALESPERSON: 201, Location points at the user, correlation echoed
the 201 body has the UserResponse fields and no password or hash
safe read by the known id returns the same user
the new account authenticates against the real service with its own role and id
ADMIN also creates INVENTORY and ADMIN accounts (each permitted human role)
the stored credential is a bcrypt hash that is not the password
exactly one audit row attributes the creation to the ADMIN token subject and the request correlation id
the audit row and the key row are single and point at the created user
a genuine SERVICE token is issued by the ADMIN for the negative cases
no credentials -> 401
malformed token -> 401
tampered signature -> 401
expired token -> 401
token signed by another key -> 401
unsecured (alg none) token -> 401
refresh token as bearer -> 401
SALESPERSON requesting ADMIN -> 403 with no successful writes
INVENTORY requesting ADMIN -> 403 with no successful writes
SERVICE requesting ADMIN -> 403 with no successful writes
SALESPERSON replaying the ADMIN key -> 403, original user/key/audit unchanged
INVENTORY replaying the ADMIN key -> 403, original user/key/audit unchanged
SERVICE replaying the ADMIN key -> 403, original user/key/audit unchanged
a validly signed ADMIN token for a user that does not exist -> 403
no user, key or audit row changed during all refused attempts
a SALESPERSON cannot read the user either (lookup is ADMIN-only) -> 403
identical authorized replay -> 200 with the original user, once
the replay did not overwrite the original audit correlation id
a different ADMIN replaying the same request and key gets the original user, no second audit row
same key with a changed intention -> 422 naming Idempotency-Key, original not shown
same email with a new key -> 422 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION on email, no key or row left
the same email in another case or with spaces is still a duplicate -> 422
role SERVICE -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
unknown role -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
short password -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
password over 72 bytes -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
malformed email -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
blank name -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
missing fields -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, nothing written
missing key -> 400
short key -> 400
129-char key -> 400
eight simultaneous identical requests -> one 201, the rest 200, one user, one audit row
an audit insert that fails -> 500 in the common envelope without SQL or secrets
the failed registration left no user, no key and no audit row (rolled back together)
after the fault is gone the same key retried -> 201 (the key was released by the rollback)
after the database restarted, rows, keys and audit rows are exactly as before
after the database restarted, the created account still authenticates
after the Auth process restarted, the same request and key still replays the original user
no password, token or refresh token appears in Auth logs, Gateway logs, audit rows or key rows
no bcrypt hash appears in the logs or the audit table

scope: Real Gateway -> built Auth -> real disposable PostgreSQL; existing registration implementation, expanded negative verification
